feedback_driven.quote: Feedback is inherently censored: the benefits and harms of loaded instructions are observable, whereas missing instructions generate feedback only when their absence causes harm.

persists_across_tasks.quote: At the start of every session, LLM agents load a fixed context file, such as $\texttt{AGENTS.md}$.

data.why_zh: 根据会话反馈增删始终加载的指令文件，属于系统提示策略演化
